# Problem

## Warehouse Location Problem - Basic Formulation

### Sets

set I; \# Potential warehouse locations set J; \# Demand points/cities

### Parameters

param d{I,J}; \# Distance/delivery cost from i to j param h{J}; \# Demand at city j param f{I}; \# Fixed cost of opening warehouse at i param B; \# Budget limit param T_max; \# Maximum delivery time param t{I,J}; \# Delivery time from i to j

### Derived parameter

param c{i in I, j in J} := d\[i,j\] \* h\[j\]; \# Cost of serving all demand at j from i

### Variables

var x{I} binary; \# Binary constraint: x_i ∈ {0,1} var y{I,J} \>= 0; \# Non-negativity: y_ij ≥ 0

### Objective: Minimize total cost

minimize Total_Cost: sum{i in I} f\[i\] \* x\[i\] + sum{i in I, j in J} c\[i,j\] \* y\[i,j\];

### Constraints

subject to Demand_Satisfaction{j in J}: sum{i in I} y\[i,j\] = 1;

subject to Open_Warehouse{i in I, j in J}: y\[i,j\] \<= x\[i\];

subject to Budget_Limit: sum{i in I} f\[i\] \* x\[i\] \<= B;

subject to Delivery_Time_Limit{j in J}: sum{i in I} t\[i,j\] \* y\[i,j\] \<= T_max;

subject to Binary_Constraint{i in I}: x\[i\] in {0,1};

subject to Non_Negativity{i in I, j in J}: y\[i,j\] \>= 0;
